breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the initial cross-sectional area (calculated from the initial diameter) for engineering stress and the initial gage length for engineering strain. This aligns with the ground truth's intent of computing engineering (not true) stress and strain, removing the erroneous instruction to use current/deformed dimensions.
